title: fix(cli)!: `os environments create` drops `--clone-from` and the unread `clone_from_environment_id` key (#21028)
body:
Fixes #21028
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

`os environments create --clone-from X` answered success and created an EMPTY environment: the CLI put the value on the create request as `clone_from_environment_id`, and the control plane never read that key (its create schema does not declare it and strips undeclared keys unread). Cloning an environment is not implemented, so the flag, the request key, the example line and the SDK request-type key are removed. This executes the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#1876 (record 5731589897); the cloud half landed in objectstack-ai/cloud#2409. The cloning capability itself (objectstack-ai/cloud#2367) is not touched here and stays a separate decision.

## What changed

- `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/create.ts`: the `clone-from` flag, the `clone_from_environment_id` request key and the `--clone-from` example line are gone. No bespoke message: a caller who still passes the flag gets oclif's own refusal.
- `packages/client/src/index.ts`: the same key is dropped from the `environments.create` request type, and the namespace docblock no longer says the CLI sends it. `create` gains a short "No `clone_from_environment_id`" note beside the existing "No `template_id`" one.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/create-clone-from.test.ts` (new): the pin. It drives the real command through `Command.run` against a client whose `fetch` records the wire request.
- `.changeset/21028-environments-create-clone-from-removed.md`: `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/client`, both `minor`, BREAKING banner, the one-line fix, and an ADR-0087 disposition (`no-migration-prescription`: no metadata changes shape, so `objectstack migrate meta` has nothing to rewrite; `check-adr-0087-registration` accepts it).

## Repro, before and after

Before, on `5dbeb7d7b7` (a scratch probe through the real `Command.run`, since deleted):

```text
os environments create --org org_1 --name Dev --no-activate --clone-from env_source
  accepted: true, exit 0
  POST /api/v1/cloud/environments  body: organization_id, display_name, plan, clone_from_environment_id = "env_source"
```

After, on `3276f760ae`:

```text
os environments create --org org_1 --name Dev --clone-from env_source --no-activate     (real CLI entry, bin/run-dev.js)
  stderr: Error: Nonexistent flag: --clone-from      exit 2      no request made
os environments create --org org_1 --name Dev --no-activate
  POST body keys: display_name, organization_id, plan   (no clone_from_environment_id)
```

## The pin, and the ablation

Four cases in the new file: a control (a create without the flag POSTs once and the body's key SET is exactly `display_name`, `organization_id`, `plan`), the flag refused in both spellings (`--clone-from X` and `--clone-from=X`: non-zero exit, `Nonexistent flag: --clone-from`, zero requests), and the flag undeclared with no `examples` line spelling a flag the command refuses.

- Against the pristine `create.ts` of `5dbeb7d7b7`: 3 of 4 red (both refusals, and the declared-flag case); the control is green.
- Ablation, each leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (anchor hit once, blob changed, restore proven by blob equals HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`). A first attempt at leg 1 was REFUSED by the tool (its anchor count did not drop, nothing ran) and was redone with a non-self-containing anchor.
  - Leg 1, flag declaration re-added: 3 of 4 red (both refusals, declared-flag case), control green.
  - Leg 2, request key re-added with a constant value (`clone_from_environment_id: 'env_source'` beside `driver`): 1 of 4 red (the control, on the key set); the three flag cases stay green.
  - Restoring the key alone, reading the now-undeclared flag, is invisible on the wire (`JSON.stringify` drops `undefined`), which is why the key-set equality exists and why leg 2 plants a value.
  - After both restores: unmutated run green (2 files, 79 tests). The pin imports `./create.js` from source, so no `dist` is involved in these legs.

## Consumers of the removed client key

- The CLI's request travels through this type: `client.environments.create({ ... })` in `create.ts` (the only non-test caller; `git grep "environments\.create\b"`).
- `git grep -niE "clone[-_]from|cloneFrom|clone_from"` over the repo, excluding `content/docs/releases` and CHANGELOGs, found only `create.ts` and the two client lines; the four `client.environments.create` calls in `client.environments-namespace.test.ts` do not pass the key. Nothing else breaks.
- The pinned sibling `../objectui` at `.objectui-sha` (`e420df310f`): `git grep -iE "clone_from_environment_id|cloneFromEnvironment|clone-from"` exits 1 (zero hits); the positive control finds `environments.*` calls in `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/provisionEnvironment.ts`. No sibling fix and no pin bump is owed.
- A TypeScript caller that passes the key now fails to compile, naming it. At runtime nothing was different, because the server dropped the key.

## Verification (head `3276f760ae`, local scope; CI owns the full farm)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`). It found one error in the first version of the new test (the `fetch` stub's parameter types), fixed in the second commit.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --project unit`: 241 files, 3413 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 50 files, 641 tests passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`: 64 commands, run one by one with the exit code captured before any pipe, all 64 exit 0, then `--ran` on that record: `64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Five of them (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`) first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `dist/`); that is NOT MEASURED, not a red. They were re-run after `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` and exit 0.
- The checkout is behind `origin/main` (`b3d7a70864` when last read). Derived again on a throwaway worktree at that tip with this commit cherry-picked on (clean, no conflict): the same 64-command list, and `--ran` on the record gives the same 64/64 there, without the stale-tree warning.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0, 2m46s, repo-wide at `3276f760ae`.
- Control-byte self-scan of the four changed files: no hits.

## Acceptance notes

- Not run locally, declared to CI: the `@objectstack/cli` integration tier (the diff touches no integration-tier file, spawn entry or driver boot path), the repo-wide `pnpm test`, and the remote gates.
- Not measured, not claimed, not filed: whether the control plane reads the other keys on the same request type (`slug`, `env_type`, `project_type`, `region`, `is_default`, `is_system`, `storage_limit_mb`) or the CLI's `--driver` and `--plan`. The control plane's source is not in this session, and no evidence says any of them is dropped. Carrier: none.
- No governed surface is touched (`.changeset/**`, `packages/cli/src/**`, `packages/client/src/**` only), and `content/docs/releases/**` and every `CHANGELOG.md` are untouched.
